source:
# Port of lib/pubid/ashrae/parser.rb — ASHRAE identifiers: standards
# (Guideline/Standard, dotted codes, comma-letter codes), ANSI/ASHRAE
# copublications, reaffirmations, errata (month/numeric dates plus
# suffixes), Interpretations, combined Addenda listings, Addendum and
# Addenda Supplement/Package forms. The gem's parse() normalization
# (whitespace collapsing, RA spacing, ", and" folding, paren balancing)
# is Tier-3 preprocessing outside the grammar. Source deviations:
# `str("")` alternatives expressed as bracketed optionals; `space?`
# inlined as [space].
#
# Edition 2 conversion. The builder is wrapper-key-driven: it reads
# base, code_with_year, errata_date, interpretation_identifier,
# combined_addenda, addenda_package and the eight addendum_* wrappers
# as HASHES with nested members, so every one of those wrappers keeps
# its capture and binds (raw) — the raw pass-through delivers the
# inner-capture Hash exactly as the v1 Parslet tree did. The keyword
# captures (errata_keyword, plus the added interpretation_keyword /
# addenda_keyword / addendum_keyword) stay as dispatch triggers. Leaf
# captures bind (string): every leaf capture body is inlined to raw
# terms because a capture wrapping a structural rule ref materializes
# the ref's element hashes and cannot bind as a string — year_digits,
# digits, reaffirmation_year, addendum_code and the optional_suffix
# body are written out at every capture site. additional_codes keeps
# its v1 wrapper (array of {addendum_code: ...} hashes) and is reached
# through the combined_addenda raw hash.

grammar PubidAshrae version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  letter = %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  lparen = "("
  rparen = ")"
  comma = ","
  colon = ":"

  publisher = "ASHRAE"
  # year_digits stays a rule for the uncaptured date suffixes below; at
  # every capture site it is inlined ("19" / "20" 2digit) because the
  # ref materializes per-character hashes inside a capture.
  year_digits = ("19" / "20") 2digit
  type = "Guideline" / "Standard"
  code = ((1*digit 0*2(dot 1*digit) [(letter 0*10(comma letter))])) as code
  code_with_year = {
    (
      ( ((1*digit 0*2(dot 1*digit) [(letter 0*10(comma letter))])) as code [[space] dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year] )
    ) as code_with_year
  }
  suffix = ("R" / "P") as suffix
  # the per-alt outer captures contain the alt2 digit materialization so
  # the raw hash never array-ifies its parent (the key is builder-unread)
  additional_copublisher = {
    ( ( ((slash ((4*10letter space [(1*digit [dash 1*digit])])) as additional_copublisher)) ) as additional_copublisher )
    / ( ( ((lparen ((("ANSI" slash (2*10letter 0*2(slash 2*10letter)))) as additional_copublisher) space [(1*digit [dash 1*digit])] rparen)) ) as additional_copublisher )
  }
  optional_suffix = {
    [space]
    lparen
    (
      "PDF"
      / (1*20letter 0*500(space / digit / comma / dash / dot / letter / "–"))
    )
    rparen
  }
  reaffirmed = {
    ( ([space] lparen "RA" [space] (("19" / "20") 2digit / 2digit) as reaffirmed rparen) )
    / ( ([space] lparen "RA" dash (("19" / "20") 2digit / 2digit) as reaffirmed rparen) )
    / ( (space "RA" space (("19" / "20") 2digit / 2digit) as reaffirmed) )
    / ( (space "RA" dash (("19" / "20") 2digit / 2digit) as reaffirmed) )
  }
  addendum_code = (([1*digit] 1*3letter)) as addendum_code
  month_name = {
      "January" / "February" / "March" / "April" / "May" / "June"
    / "July" / "August" / "September" / "October" / "November" / "December"
  }

  errata_date = {
    (
      ( ([space] lparen (month_name) as month space (1*2digit) as day [comma] (space / [comma]) (("19" / "20") 2digit) as errata_year rparen) ) as errata_date
      / ( ([space] lparen (month_name) as month space (1*2digit) as day rparen) ) as errata_date
      / ( ([space] lparen ((1*2digit dash 1*2digit dash [space] ("19" / "20") 2digit)) as numeric_date rparen) ) as errata_date
    )
  }
  errata_suffix = 0*3(space ("-" / "–") space (letter 0*50(space / letter / digit / comma)))
  errata_date_and_suffix = {
    (errata_suffix errata_date)
    / (errata_date errata_suffix)
    / errata_date
    / errata_suffix
  }
  errata_paren_date = {
    ([space] lparen month_name space 1*2digit [comma] (space / [comma]) year_digits rparen)
    / ([space] lparen month_name space 1*2digit rparen)
    / ([space] lparen 1*2digit dash 1*2digit dash [space] year_digits rparen)
  }
  errata_suffix_on_addendum = space "Errata" as errata_on_addendum_kw [errata_paren_date]

  ansi_copub = {
    (
      ("ANSI" dash "ASHRAE")
      / ("ANSI" slash "ASHRAE" 0*10(slash 3*10letter))
    ) as copublisher
  }
  ansi_copub_space = ((("ANSI" slash "ASHRAE" 0*10(slash 3*10letter))) as copublisher space)

  errata_identifier = {
    (
      (
        ( ( (ansi_copub) space (type) as type space (code)
            [([space] dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
            [(space (additional_copublisher))]
            [(suffix)]
            [(reaffirmed)]
          ) ) as base
        space "Errata" as errata_keyword
        [errata_date_and_suffix]
        [( (1*2 ([space] lparen ("PDF" / ((1*20letter 0*500(space / digit / comma / dash / dot / letter / "–")))) rparen)) as optional_suffixes )]
      )
      / (
        ( ( (ansi_copub) space (code_with_year)
            [(space (additional_copublisher))]
            [(suffix)]
            [(reaffirmed)]
          ) ) as base
        space "Errata" as errata_keyword
        [errata_date_and_suffix]
        [( (1*2 ([space] lparen ("PDF" / ((1*20letter 0*500(space / digit / comma / dash / dot / letter / "–")))) rparen)) as optional_suffixes )]
      )
      / (
        ( ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
            [([space] dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
            [(space (additional_copublisher))]
            [(suffix)]
            [(reaffirmed)]
          ) ) as base
        space "Errata" as errata_keyword
        [errata_date_and_suffix]
        [( (1*2 ([space] lparen ("PDF" / ((1*20letter 0*500(space / digit / comma / dash / dot / letter / "–")))) rparen)) as optional_suffixes )]
      )
    )
  }

  interpretation_identifier = {
    (
      (
        "Interpretations" as interpretation_keyword
        space "for" space
        ( ( (type) as type space (code) [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)] ) ) as base
      )
    ) as interpretation_identifier
  }

  combined_addenda_identifier = {
    (
      (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( ( 0*20(
                ((comma) space "and" space (addendum_code))
                / ((space) "and" space (addendum_code))
                / 1*50((comma) space (addendum_code))
                / 1*50((comma) (addendum_code))
              ) ) as additional_codes )]
          space ("to" / "for") space
          [(ansi_copub_space)]
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(space (additional_copublisher))]
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          [addendum_date_suffix]
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
          (dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)
          ((colon space) / space)
          "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( ( 1*50((comma) space (addendum_code)) / 1*50((comma) (addendum_code)) ) as additional_codes )]
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( ( 0*20(
                ((comma) space "and" space (addendum_code))
                / ((space) "and" space (addendum_code))
                / 1*20((comma) space (addendum_code))
                / 1*20((comma) (addendum_code))
              ) ) as additional_codes )]
          space ("to" / "for") space
          [(ansi_copub_space)]
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          ("to" / "for") space
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( ( 0*20(
                ((comma) space "and" space (addendum_code))
                / ((space) "and" space (addendum_code))
                / 1*20((comma) space (addendum_code))
                / 1*20((comma) (addendum_code))
              ) ) as additional_codes )]
          space ("to" / "for") space
          (code_with_year)
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( ( 0*20(
                ((comma) space "and" space (addendum_code))
                / ((space) "and" space (addendum_code))
                / 1*20((comma) space (addendum_code))
                / 1*20((comma) (addendum_code))
              ) ) as additional_codes )]
          space ("to" / "for") space
          (code_with_year)
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          ((colon space) / space)
          "Addenda" as addenda_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( ( ((space "through" space (addendum_code))
                / 1*200(((space) / ((comma) space)) (addendum_code))
                / 1*200((comma) space (addendum_code))
                / 1*200((comma) (addendum_code))) ) as additional_codes )]
          [(space (additional_copublisher))]
        ) ) as combined_addenda
          [addendum_date_suffix]
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
    )
  }

  year_first_addenda_package_identifier = {
    (
      ( ( (("19" / "20") 2digit) as package_year
          space
          (
            ( "Addenda" space "Supplement" [(space "Package")] space "to" space
              [(ansi_copub_space)]
              (type) as type space (code)
              [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
            )
            / (
              "Supplement" space "Addenda" space (addendum_code)
              [( ( 1*50((comma) space (addendum_code)) / 1*50((comma) (addendum_code)) ) as additional_codes )]
              space "to" space
              [(ansi_copub_space)]
              (type) as type space (code)
              [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
            )
            / (
              "Addenda" space "Supplement" space "to" space
              [(ansi_copub_space)]
              (type) as type space (code)
              [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
            )
            / (
              "Supplement" space "to" space
              [(ansi_copub_space)]
              (type) as type space (code)
              [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
              [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
            )
          )
      ) ) as addenda_package
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
    )
  }

  addenda_package_identifier = {
    (
      (
        ( (ansi_copub_space)
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          ((colon space) / space)
          "Addenda" space
          ((("Supplement" [(space "Package")]) / "Package")) as package_description
          [(space "for" space (("19" / "20") 2digit) as target_year)]
        ) ) as addenda_package
          0*3 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          (comma) space "Addenda" space
          (("19" / "20") 2digit) as package_year space "Supplement" (colon) space
          "Addenda" space
          ((("Supplement" [(space "Package")]) / "Package")) as package_description
        ) ) as addenda_package
          0*3 (optional_suffix)
      / (
        ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(space (("19" / "20") 2digit) as package_year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [(suffix)]
          [(reaffirmed)]
          ((colon space) / space)
          "Addenda" space
          ((("Supplement" [(space "Package")]) / "Package")) as package_description
          [(space "for" space (("19" / "20") 2digit) as target_year)]
        ) ) as addenda_package
          0*3 (optional_suffix)
    )
  }

  addendum_date_suffix = {
    space
    lparen
    month_name
    space
    1*2digit
    [comma]
    (space / [comma])
    year_digits
    rparen
  }

  addendum_identifier = {
    (
      ( ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as publisher_addendum
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          (publisher) as base_publisher space
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as publisher_base_addendum
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( [[(ansi_copub_space)]]
          "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          (publisher) as base_publisher space
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as publisher_base_addendum
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          (ansi_copub_space)
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as publisher_addendum_copublisher
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( (publisher) as publisher space "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          (ansi_copub_space)
          (code_with_year)
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as publisher_addendum_copublisher_no_type
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( [[(ansi_copub_space)]]
          "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          [(ansi_copub_space)]
          (code_with_year)
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as addendum_no_type
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( [[(ansi_copub_space)]]
          "Addendum" as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code) space ("to" / "for") space
          [(ansi_copub_space)]
          (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as addendum
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [(suffix)]
          [(reaffirmed)]
          ((colon space) / space)
          ("Addendum" / "addendum") as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as standard_addendum
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
      / ( ( (publisher) as publisher space (type) as type space (code)
          [(dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
          [(additional_copublisher)]
          [(suffix)]
          [(reaffirmed)]
          space ("Addendum" / "addendum") as addendum_keyword space
          (addendum_code)
          [( (addendum_date_suffix) ) as addendum_date]
          [( (errata_suffix_on_addendum) ) as errata_on_addendum]
      ) ) as standard_addendum
          0*2 (optional_suffix)
    )
  }

  identifier = {
      errata_identifier
    / interpretation_identifier
    / year_first_addenda_package_identifier
    / addenda_package_identifier
    / addendum_identifier
    / combined_addenda_identifier
    / (
      ( (( [( "ANSI" (slash) )] 2*10(!("ASHRAE") letter)) as copublisher )
        space (code_with_year)
        0*2 (optional_suffix)
      )
    )
    / (
      ( (ansi_copub) space (code_with_year)
        [(space (additional_copublisher))]
        [(suffix)]
        [(reaffirmed)]
        0*2 (optional_suffix)
      )
    )
    / (
      ( (ansi_copub) space [(type) as type] [space] (code)
        [([space] dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
        [(space (additional_copublisher))]
        [(suffix)]
        [(reaffirmed)]
        0*2 (optional_suffix)
      )
    )
    / (
      ( (publisher) as publisher space
        [((type) as type space)]
        (code)
        [([space] dash (("19" / "20") 2digit) as year)]
        [(space (additional_copublisher))]
        [(suffix)]
        [(reaffirmed)]
      ) ) as base
        0*2 (optional_suffix)
  }

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    # leaves the builder reads flat (or that ride along for lint parity)
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    type -> type (string)
    code -> code (string)
    year -> year (string)
    suffix -> suffix (string)
    reaffirmed -> reaffirmed (string)
    copublisher -> copublisher (string)
    additional_copublisher -> additional_copublisher (raw)
    addendum_code -> addendum_code (string)
    month -> month (string)
    day -> day (string)
    errata_year -> errata_year (string)
    numeric_date -> numeric_date (string)
    errata_keyword -> errata_keyword (string)
    optional_suffixes -> optional_suffixes (string)
    package_description -> package_description (string)
    package_year -> package_year (string)
    target_year -> target_year (string)
    base_publisher -> base_publisher (string)
    interpretation_keyword -> interpretation_keyword (string)
    addenda_keyword -> addenda_keyword (string)
    addendum_keyword -> addendum_keyword (string)
    addendum_date -> addendum_date (raw)
    errata_on_addendum -> errata_on_addendum (raw)
    # the wrapper hashes the builder dispatches on and unwraps
    base -> base (raw)
    code_with_year -> code_with_year (raw)
    errata_date -> errata_date (raw)
    interpretation_identifier -> interpretation_identifier (raw)
    combined_addenda -> combined_addenda (raw)
    addenda_package -> addenda_package (raw)
    publisher_addendum -> publisher_addendum (raw)
    publisher_base_addendum -> publisher_base_addendum (raw)
    publisher_addendum_copublisher -> publisher_addendum_copublisher (raw)
    publisher_addendum_copublisher_no_type -> publisher_addendum_copublisher_no_type (raw)
    addendum_no_type -> addendum_no_type (raw)
    addendum -> addendum (raw)
    standard_addendum -> standard_addendum (raw)
  }

  test {
    accept "ASHRAE 62.1"
    accept "ASHRAE Standard 55-2020"
    accept "ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 135-2020"
    accept "ASHRAE 55-2020 (RA 2019)"
    accept "ASHRAE Addendum a to Standard 135-2020"
    accept "ASHRAE Guideline 0-2005 Errata (September 28, 2011) (PDF)"
    accept "Interpretations for Standard 15.2-2022"
    accept "ASHRAE Standard 55-2004 Addenda a, b, c, d"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
